deadline.value: Doctoral applications for fall entry should reach admissions by February 15; the catalog says applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

also.quote: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

gre_general.value: The department does not require GRE scores for the PhD.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: The department sets its own TOEFL minimum of 79 for non-native English speakers; the catalog does not say which TOEFL format.
toefl_min.quote: a minimum score of 79 TOEFL, or a minimum score of 53 PTE, or a minimum score of 6.5 IELTS is required for admission

ielts_min.value: The department also requires an IELTS overall band of 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: a minimum score of 6.5 IELTS is required for admission

supervisor.value: Each doctoral student gets an academic advisor after admission; the catalog does not say a supervisor must agree before admission.
supervisor.quote: All students pursuing a doctoral degree will have an academic advisor (and co-advisor, if applicable) who must be a member of the Missouri S&T graduate faculty.

funding.value: The catalog gives no funding statement for the PhD.

entry_route.value: The catalog does not say whether a master's is needed before the PhD.

notes: Department PhD pages on the mst.edu subdomains could not be reached (TLS verification failure through the proxy); this record uses the graduate catalog only.
